content: {"outdated": false, "reason": "The earlier version (2023-09-01) only allows deferral of the entire old-age pension ('den Beginn des Rentenbezuges', 'le début du versement de la rente', 'l’inizio del godimento della rendita') and does not provide for partial deferral. The concept of a minimum share (20%) is introduced in the current version (2026-01-01). Therefore, the earlier text does not answer the same question."}
